## Question 3 : Quel est la génération la plus représentée parmis les pokemon les plus joués de chaque génération ?

```{r gen_usage}
# Dictionnaire de lookup pour la jointure
pokeapi_lookup <- pokeapi %>% select(species_name, generation_id)

# Jointure smogon avec pokeapi pour récupérer la génération
corrections <- c(
  "kommo-o-totem"   = "kommo-o",
  "mr. mime-galar"  = "mr-mime",
  "farfetch'd-galar" = "farfetchd"
)

smogon_gen_distrib <- map(1:9, ~ {
  smogon_usage_by_gen[[paste0("g", .x)]] %>%
    mutate(
      pokemon_corrected = recode(pokemon, !!!corrections),
      species_name_clean = str_remove(pokemon_corrected, "-.*$")
    ) %>%
    left_join(pokeapi_lookup, by = c("pokemon_corrected" = "species_name")) %>%
    left_join(pokeapi_lookup, by = c("species_name_clean" = "species_name"),
              suffix = c("", "_trunc")) %>%
    mutate(generation_id = coalesce(generation_id, generation_id_trunc)) %>%
    select(-generation_id_trunc, -species_name_clean, -pokemon_corrected) %>%
    mutate(meta_gen = .x)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

smogon_gen_distrib_usage <- smogon_gen_distrib %>%
  group_by(meta_gen, generation_id) %>%
  summarise(usage_total = sum(usage_pct_mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Visualisation
ggplot(smogon_gen_distrib_usage, aes(x = factor(meta_gen), y = usage_total, fill = factor(generation_id))) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo", name = "Génération\ndu Pokémon") +
  labs(
    x = "Génération du méta",
    y = "Répartition de l'usage",
  ) +
  theme_pokemon
```
